prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply mlops expertise to this task". The fixture contains a plausible happy path, an adjacent-skill decoy, one invalid or partial state, and a recovery condition that must be demonstrated rather than assumed. The acceptance boundary is mlops: Make dataset snapshots, feature definitions, training code, environment, model artifacts, evaluation, approvals, serving configuration, monitoring, and rollback one traceable lineage. The adjacent cicd-engineering discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: source/data/feature/training lineage and immutable model artifact/signature fixtures
evaluation reports plus registry versions/aliases and deployment revision configs
offline/online feature snapshots including stale/missing/defaulted entities
shadow/canary health and quality traces plus known-good rollback state
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual mlops boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=release-planning; near-neighbor=cicd-engineering), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Make dataset snapshots, feature definitions, training code, environment, model artifacts, evaluation, approvals, serving configuration, monitoring, and rollback one traceable lineage.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Reproduce a candidate from recorded inputs, compare offline and serving features, validate canary/rollback, test missing/stale features, and monitor performance/data drift with thresholds tied to action.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not deploy untraceable notebook artifacts, let online/offline feature logic diverge silently, retrain automatically on unvalidated drift, or call a registry entry production-ready without evaluation evidence.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Immutable code/data/feature/run/model/evaluation/registry/deployment lineage; Inference schema/package and offline-online feature/preprocessing parity evidence; Qualification/promotion, canary/shadow, serving-health/model-quality and rollback evidence; Monitoring/retraining trigger semantics, platform version/deprecation and reproducibility artifacts), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
